description: Write a fact, decision, pattern, preference, error or debt to a neuron (created when the topic matches none). Recall first: it may exist. A replacement passes supersedes; retiring without one is crbro_revise; deleting is crbro_forget. A value that can change names its source (file, key, URL, person). Repeating a fact merges metadata, never verifies it (crbro_revise status=verified does). One claim per fact: past ~600 characters the answer suggests splitting; a huge neuron, crbro_revise move_to. Credentials become markers: crbro_secret them, store only the name. Returns neuron_id, action, shelf_life, near_duplicates, supersedes_unmatched (still live).

content.description: Self-contained: recalled without this conversation. For a changeable value, say where it came from (file, key, URL, person).

domain.description: Set on a new neuron, or replacing "general".

keywords.description: Facts, expected: 2-5 words a future question may use that the text lacks (synonyms, other language, generic name).

keywords_replace.description: Replace, not merge, the keywords of an identical fact.

neuron_id.description: Exact id from crbro_recall; skips name matching.

reference.description: Facts: where to check it (relative file, URL, person). Data, never fetched.

shelf_life.description: Facts: volatile (versions, ports, hosts, config, roles) to permanent (history). Inferred if omitted.

supersedes.description: Ids or exact text of the facts this replaces; unmatched ones stay live.

temporal.description: Facts: current state (default) or a historical record.

topic.description: Topic name, e.g. "OctoChat"; or pass neuron_id.

type.description: error = a mistake with its fix; debt = a deliberate deferral with its ceiling and revisit trigger.

name: crbro_learn
title: Learn something
